description: Retrieve domain registration data via RDAP (with WHOIS fallback): registrar, creation/expiry/update dates, nameservers, and EPP status flags, highlighting risk states such as clientHold and pendingDelete. Use this for ownership, lifecycle, and expiry questions about a registered domain. Use dns_lookup instead for live DNS records, or reverse_dns/asn_lookup for IP-level ownership. Read-only; requires no API key; rate-limited. Returns registrar, key dates, nameservers, and status flags.

domain.description: Registered domain name to look up (e.g., 'example.com'). A subdomain is normalized to its registrable domain.

name: whois_lookup

actions.description: Recommended next actions, most important first

grade.description: Letter grade (A+ to F) when the tool grades the target

reportUrl.description: Human-facing interactive report for this exact lookup on dechonet.com

score.description: 0-100 score when the tool scores the target
